summary: The Sync button is gone from a Result Selection window; comparing one against its ResQ counterpart is now done only by the Sync Reserving Class with ResQ macro.
details: The button on the Result Selection tab bar, and the version-comparison window it opened, have been removed.
The macro already does the same comparison across a whole reserving class, in a form that reports what it found before anything is written.
Nothing about a saved Result Selection changes: the same figures, the same file, and the same behaviour everywhere else in the window.
